summary: M9 verification GREEN across backend + frontend. Backend: POST /api/vision/verify-object (Gemini 2.5 Flash) passes all 6 pytest cases — real cartoon-avatar PNG returns match=true with confidence>0.5 for target 'a cartoon avatar' (got ~0.95 region), match=false for 'a glass of water', empty image_base64 -> 400, missing/empty target_object -> 400/422, malformed b64 -> 400. Frontend: /xp?from=photo renders purple 220px badge with XP=40, headline 'You won 40 XP!' matches the badge, NO pageerror on mount (tada SFX rejection handled by useOneShotSfx .catch()), Continue routes to /(main). /reward?from=photo no longer renders xp-line and Continue chains to /xp?from=photo; streak count persists/idempotent (count=1). /challenges/photo permission gate subtitle now contains '...your photo is only used to verify the object then discarded.', after granting permission the round white shutter (testID photo-capture-button) is visible and there is NO auto-capture after 3s — confirmed by waiting 4s with shutter still present. Tapping the shutter on web short-circuits to 'Web preview can't capture photos — try a real device.' with the Try-again retry pill (testID photo-retry-button). /alarm-edit Sound row: tapping a ringtone (Classic) does NOT dismiss the sheet, the volume-high icon appears on the selected row; tapping Tropical Marimba keeps sheet open and updates the icon selection; Done button (last) closes sheet; alarm-edit Sound row reflects last selection ('Tropical Marimba'); 'Test alarm' button removed. Alarm card on /(main): orange-bordered Preview pill rendered bottom-right (testID alarm-preview-<id>, box x=244 width=94 on a 375-wide screen) and tapping it routes to /alarm-ring?id=<id> NOT /alarm-edit. The single pageerror seen on /challenges/photo is the browser autoplay-gate warning from useAlarmAudio (alarm ringtone), pre-existing benign — the tada/fanfare SFX themselves do NOT throw thanks to the .catch() rejection handlers in use-one-shot-sfx.ts.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/vision.py is clean: 400 for empty/invalid base64, 422 via Pydantic for missing target_object, 400 for empty target_object after strip(). Gemini 2.5 Flash call is wrapped with try/except and falls back to a permissive no-match response if the LLM returns unparseable JSON — good UX for half-awake users.
/app/frontend/src/hooks/use-one-shot-sfx.ts catches the play()-promise rejection so the tada SFX cannot surface as a pageerror — confirmed empirically on /xp (0 page errors).
/app/frontend/app/reward.tsx no longer mentions XP; Continue uses encodeURIComponent on the `from` param before pushing to /xp — correct.

/app/frontend/app/(main)/index.tsx Preview pill calls e.stopPropagation?.() before onPreview() so the card's own onPress (which routes to /alarm-edit) does NOT also fire — verified: tap goes to /alarm-ring, not /alarm-edit.

/app/frontend/app/alarm-edit.tsx sound picker: tap on PickerOption only calls update({ringtoneId}) + previewSound() — no setSheet(null), so the sheet stays open until Done/X — correct. previewRef.current is pause()->remove()'d before starting a new player, preventing overlapping audio.
seed_data_creation: none — alarms persisted via in-browser AsyncStorage during the same Playwright session
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend vision endpoint is REAL (Gemini 2.5 Flash via emergentintegrations + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env). Tests use /app/frontend/assets/images/avatars/01.png as a real visual image — do NOT use blank/solid-color images for vision tests (per /app/image_testing.md). /xp screen has testIDs xp-screen, xp-amount (numeric), xp-continue-button. /reward Continue now chains to /xp?from=<challenge>. /challenges/photo no longer auto-captures — user must tap photo-capture-button; on web it short-circuits with photo-retry-button. Alarm card Preview pill testID is alarm-preview-<alarm.id> and routes to /alarm-ring?id=<id>. AsyncStorage is reset between separate browser_automation_tool calls (incognito context per run), so seed alarms in the same session if needed.
